title: Road Blocked 2
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 3 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 2 \leq N \leq 2 \times 10^5; 1 \leq M \leq 2 \times 10^5; 1 \leq A_i < B_i \leq N; All pairs (A_i, B_i) are distinct.; 1 \leq C_i \leq 10^9; City N can be reached from city 1 when all roads are passable.; All input values are integers.
